text_block_list.text:
As I was planning out the race schedule, 
evening crept up on me before I knew it.

Before I knew it, Mejiro Ramonu had picked 
up the race plan and was reviewing it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Devotedly offering up the tiny, spilled 
fragments of love—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: As a fable, it's quite lovely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
What I wish to dedicate to you is not mere 
fragments of love, but love itself.

Mejiro Ramonu looks down at me with a 
heavy, piercing gaze.

Perhaps I loved racing the wrong way. I 
should reconsider my future race plans...
